description: Ω2 vault spine — SQLite WAL+FTS5 canonical store, content-addressed CAS (write-tmp→fsync→rename), Merkle-chained changelog, verify walk, refs-honoring compaction, roundtrip swap harness. Owns vault format v1; the data dir belongs to the user's vault (config.dataDir), never to this plugin.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: object id within ns; non-empty, no '|'

fields.name: rev
fields.doc: per-(ns,id) revision; starts at 1, increments per append (allocated from the changelog, compaction-proof)

fields.name: cid
fields.doc: sha256 hex of canonical JSON of data; the CAS blob address cas/<cid[0:2]>/<cid>

fields.name: data
fields.doc: structured-clone-safe payload; stored content-addressed, small payloads inline via the same CAS

fields.name: meta
fields.doc: caller metadata object; stored in objects.meta envelope {meta, refs} and returned verbatim by vault.get@1

fields.name: refs
fields.doc: provenance edges [{ns, id, rev}]; referenced revisions survive compaction

schema.doc: vault.object v1 — the stored object shape (D3 03-WAVE-SPECS §1 vault format v1).

contract.doc: D-432: two-phase append — append.intent journaled+fsynced before the data transaction, append.commit after; intent-without-commit never enters the fold.

D-387: bounded batch of latest-rev-per-id reads (ids ≤ 512 distinct) — one port hop instead of one per id; missing ids are {found:false} data, malformed envelopes and missing CAS blobs still throw fail-closed.
D-432: plan-driven path via planRef {ns, keep, censusDigest} — dry-run-first, VAULT_COMPACTION_REFERENCED_BLOB guard, receipt row; legacy (ns, keep) shape keeps protective-skip semantics.
D-432: the reference census + ledgered plan row; its only write is its own ledgered plan (READ-only over schema and object rows).
D-432: the crash-recovery ceremony — torn tails quarantined verbatim + ledgered as vault.recovery rows; also automatic on boot.
D-432: migration census + ledgered plan row; stamps the implicit genesis version so every rollback point cites a real row.
D-432: schema change through the versioned registry; refuses VAULT_MIGRATION_REQUIRES_DRYRUN / VAULT_MIGRATION_ROLLBACK_UNCITED.
D-432: namespace-scoped chain-preserving archive (segment + blobs + seals + retention manifest + quarantine evidence); refuses VAULT_EXPORT_SCOPE_UNNAMED.
D-432: verified merge into a caller-named fresh vault dir; refuses VAULT_IMPORT_CHAIN_MISMATCH on divergence, mid-chain segments, non-empty targets.
D-432: copies the quarantine zone with the fold (a copy's recovery rows keep their evidence).

capabilities.justification: Self-contained by construction: the vault data dir is user-vault territory (ctx.config.dataDir passthrough) and every capability this plugin needs is its own storage; roundtrip writes only to a caller-specified target dir, gated as EXTERNAL_MUTATION by law.
